name: Sad Liza AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #161: Belly of the Black Whale

items.name: Dagger
items.description: This small, bladed weapon is held in one hand and used to stab a creature in close combat. It can also be thrown.

items.name: +2 Greater Striking War Razor
items.description: A war razor is an exaggerated version of the barbers' tool. It is a brittle but extremely sharp weapon that is very easy to slip into a pocket or sleeve.

items.name: +2 Resilient Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

items.name: Necklace of Fireballs VI
items.description:
This string of beads appears to be a hemp string with lustrous red beads of various sizes hanging from it. When activated, it briefly appears in its true form: a golden chain with golden spheres attached by fine threads.

This necklace has one @Damage[16d6[fire]] damage, three @Damage[14d6[fire]] damage and four @Damage[12d6[fire]] damage beads with a Reflex save DC of 36. When all the beads are gone, the necklace becomes a non-magical hemp string.

Activate A Interact

Effect You detach a sphere from the necklace, causing it to glow with orange light. After you activate a sphere, if you or anyone else hurls it (an Interact action with the ranged trait), it detonates as a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fireball] where it lands. Your toss can place the center of the fireball anywhere within 70 feet, though at the GM's discretion you might need to make an attack roll if the throw is unusually challenging. If no one hurls the sphere by the start of your next turn, it turns into a non-magical red bead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Bloody Mayhem
offensiveAbilities.description: Sad Liza Strides three times. Once per Stride, she can attempt a war razor Strike against a creature in her reach at any point during the Stride; she must make each Strike against a different creature, but she doesn't apply her multiple attack penalty until after making all her Strikes. If any of the Strikes are a critical failure, Bloody Mayhem immediately ends.

offensiveAbilities.name: Close Cutter
offensiveAbilities.description: Whenever Sad Liza deals slashing damage, the target takes an additional 2d10 persistent bleed damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fan of Daggers
offensiveAbilities.description: Sad Liza makes three ranged dagger Strikes, each against a separate target; she ignores the multiple attack penalty until after making all three Strikes. On a critical hit, the target takes 2d10 Bleed Damage damage and is Blinded for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Knife Thrower
offensiveAbilities.description: Sad Liza's ranged dagger Strikes have a range increment of 20 feet instead of 10 feet.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Sad Liza deals an additional 3d6 precision damage to Off-Guard targets.
